### Checklist

- [ ] One or more `.RfxChain` files, added directly in `Community/`, and nothing else.
- [ ] File name is `<Plugin> - <Author>.RfxChain` (`Panel only - <Author>` when the chain holds no plugin).
- [ ] Tested: loaded on an empty track, the Direct Links rebuild and the controls move the plugin.
- [ ] The chain contains no sample, impulse response or other file from my disk.
- [ ] I created this preset and I agree to its distribution with StripTease under the Contributions section of `licence.md`.
